description: Hand-authored MIND-format rows for parser, inventory, split and metric tests. Not evidence of real user behavior; IDs, titles and clicks are invented.

edge_cases.train news: empty abstract (N2, N7); empty entity fields (N7); quote character (N5); non-ASCII (N8); several categories incl. sports
edge_cases.train behaviors: empty history (U2); no-click (3); multiple clicks (2, 5); all candidates clicked (5, 6); single candidate (6); 3 and 12 candidates (1, 4); last second before cutoff (7) and exactly at cutoff (8); identical timestamps (9, 10); same user in fit and tune (U1); 12:00 AM and 12:30 PM parsing; history of 7 items (U6)
edge_cases.dev: candidates unseen in train (N15-N18); user unseen in train (U7); candidate missing from every news.tsv (N99); no-click (103)
